settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Adjust the interface language and general preferences. Changes apply immediately without a restart.
settings.languageHint: Pick the language for the desktop UI. Takes effect instantly and does not change the subtitle translation target.
settings.translationPreferenceHint: Set the target language for LLM translation output. Defaults to the interface language, or enter a custom language name.
settings.translationPreferenceCustomPlaceholder: Enter the target language, e.g. Japanese, French, Simplified Chinese
settings.overlayHint: Tune overlay opacity, colors, font and lock state.
settings.overlayPageSubtitle: Changes here are applied to the subtitle overlay immediately so you can fine-tune readability for games and videos.
settings.overlayPreviewHint: This preview updates in real time. If the overlay window is open, it will reflect the same changes.
settings.overlayPreviewTranslation: Translated subtitles appear on the next line
settings.overlayAppearanceHint: Overall opacity affects both the card and text, while background and text opacity can be tuned separately.
settings.overlayLockHint: Lock the current position. Hover over the overlay to unlock it when you need to move it again.
settings.providersHint: Manage provider templates, credentials and probes. Open the Providers page for detailed configuration.
settings.resetWelcomeHint: Clear the local flag so the quick setup wizard appears again on next launch.
settings.resetWelcomeDone: Reset done. The wizard will appear next time.

welcome.title: Welcome to Omni Translate
welcome.subtitle: Pick a language, connect a provider, then check the driver and bridge. You can update these anytime from Settings.
welcome.hint: Pick a language from the list below; click to switch instantly.
welcome.stepProviderDescription: Choose a provider template and enter your API key to finish setup.
welcome.apiKeySaveTimeout: Saving the API key timed out, so the app could not confirm it was written to the local credential store. Check whether Windows Credential Manager is available, then try again.
welcome.apiKeySaveInvokeTimeout: The native API key save command did not return within 7 seconds. Check the console and diagnostics traces under storage or provider-runtime to confirm whether the request reached Rust.
welcome.apiKeySaveUiTimeout: The frontend has been waiting more than 15 seconds for the API key save result. The native command may still be running; check the console and diagnostics traces under storage or provider-runtime.
welcome.apiKeySavedDeferred: API key saved. DashScope realtime models should be validated after device and audio routing are ready, so you can continue with driver setup first.
welcome.apiKeyProbeFailed: API key saved, but the connectivity check did not pass. You can continue with driver setup now and retry later from Settings > Providers.
welcome.apiKeyProbeTimeout: API key saved, but the connectivity check timed out. Check the network, endpoint, and API key, or continue with driver setup now and retry later from Settings > Providers.
welcome.apiKeyRevealSuccess: Loaded the saved API key from the local credential store.
welcome.apiKeyRevealEmpty: No saved API key was found for the selected provider.
welcome.providerHint: The key is stored securely in the local credential store and can be managed later in Settings › Providers.
welcome.providerFootHint: No key right now? Skip this step and fill it in later from the Settings page.
welcome.stepDriverDescription: Check the virtual microphone driver and bridge before you start. You can install or repair them here.
welcome.driverFootHint: You can enter viewing mode now and continue repairs later from Settings > Driver management.

status.secureBootEnabled: Secure Boot is blocking the test driver

description.secureBootEnabled: Disable Secure Boot in BIOS/UEFI, enable TESTSIGNING, restart Windows, then try again.
description.notInstalled: Install the virtual microphone driver to enable translated audio routing.
description.needsRepair: Repair the driver, then run detection again. Diagnostic details are available below.
description.bridgeStopped: Start the bridge service to connect the installed driver.

driverManagement.feedbackNeedsAttention: Detection completed. The driver still needs attention.
driverManagement.feedbackFailed: The driver operation failed. Open advanced details for the error code and recent log.

audioRouting.sendVoiceToVirtualMic: Send translated voice to virtual microphone
audioRouting.feedbackLoopPreventionDesc: Prevent translated speech from being re-captured as new input

audioRouting.feedbackLoopPreventionEchoCancelDesc: Subtract played audio from captured signal in real time

audioRouting.feedbackLoopPreventionVirtualDriverDisab: Virtual audio driver is not running. Install or start it from Diagnostics first.

audioRouting.outboundModelUnsupportedTitle: This model may not support microphone translated output

audioRouting.modelUnsupportedPrompt: This model is missing capabilities required by the currently enabled outputs. You can still select it and keep the checkboxes unchanged.
audioRouting.enableProviderTemplate: Enable a provider template before choosing voice models.
audioRouting.nativeModeDescription: Use the voice model's native subtitle translation.
audioRouting.secondaryTranslationDescription: Show source text first, then translate each sentence with a text model.
